descriptions.d30d_game_update_8015e0e0: Per-frame scene update and render. Creates four named profile records on first use, converts elapsed milliseconds to seconds and advances the clock at +52, updates the items between the first and last visible index, then times culling, drawing and overlay drawing into +152, +156 and +160 using the 64-bit timer 0x801fe4d8. Returns zero.
